title: ESIC Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 04 Professor and Assistant Professor Posts
description: Employees State Insurance Corporation Dental College & Hospital, Kalaburagi (ESIC Dental College Kalaburagi) has declared the latest job notification for the recruitment of 04 Professor and Assistant Professor positions. Candidates who have qualified in BDS or MDS can grab this chance and apply for the ESIC Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, applciation fee, and how to apply for these posts. Interested and eligible ...
